name: Marta
bio: Runs the inn where delvers rest in HOLLOWDEEP. Forty years watching folk go down the bottomless hole.

portrait.subject: a cute sturdy middle-aged innkeeper woman with rosy cheeks, a grey bun, a flour-dusted apron and a big steaming bowl of stew
portrait.background: warm mountain inn with a fireplace and wooden beams

request: Marta, from the inn at Brindlemoor. HOLLOWDEEP. Come rest your delvers, and be my friend. 🍲
hello: Good! There's always a bed and a bowl for you.
Odo's got new gear in. Tell him Marta sent you.
about: I'm Marta. Forty years ago the ground split open under the mountain. Delvers come, delvers go down. I keep the stew hot for the ones who come back.
how: A first-person dungeon crawler: hire up to five delvers from six classes, gear them, map the corridors and fight in turn-based battles.
tips: Front row: Fighters and Knights. Back row: Mages and Rangers.
Map every floor. The Hollow loves to loop.
Rest at my inn before going deeper!
chat: A delver brought me a glowing mushroom. It's on the mantel.
Odo raised his prices. I gave him a look.
The hole rumbled last night. The stew rippled.
nudge: Your delvers are rested and fed. Down you go!
A new floor's been found! The Guild's buzzing!
idle: {ago}! Your rooms are paid up and your delvers are restless.
The stew's been simmering {ago}. Come back safe.
progress: Deepest floor: {floor}! Nobody's been further this year!

questions.q: Which class would you hire first?

update: Guild notice: HOLLOWDEEP is now v{version}!
bye: Marta's off to stir the pot.
